001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Custom exception for stream processing errors.
007 *
008 * <p>This exception is thrown when errors occur during stream processing operations, providing
009 * meaningful context about the failure while preserving the original exception information.
010 *
011 * <p>Extends {@link java.io.IOException} so that callers of {@link
012 * com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level failures with a
013 * single {@code catch (IOException)} block, consistent with the method's checked-exception
014 * contract.
015 */
016public class StreamProcessingException extends IOException {
017  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
018
019  /**
020   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message.
021   *
022   * @param message the detail message
023   */
024  public StreamProcessingException(String message) {
025    super(message);
026  }
027
028  /**
029   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message and cause.
030   *
031   * @param message the detail message
032   * @param cause the cause of the exception
033   */
034  public StreamProcessingException(String message, Throwable cause) {
035    super(message, cause);
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified cause.
040   *
041   * @param cause the cause of the exception
042   */
043  public StreamProcessingException(Throwable cause) {
044    super(cause);
045  }
046}
